observers.name: Bay Trail, Richmond Annex

observers.name: Albany Bulb
observers.notes: Landfill mound with roughly 10-12 m of accessible relief. The predicted critical observer height for downtown San Francisco is ~11.4 m refracted against ~13.1 m geometric, so this is the one site on the route where the transition can be walked.

targets.notes: Low made ground on the line between the Albany shore and downtown San Francisco. Kind is fixed, not summit: it is genuinely flat, and a summit search from here reaches Yerba Buena Island 1.5 km away and returns that instead.

structures.name: Golden Gate Bridge
structures.source: Derived: Overture base/infrastructure 'Golden Gate Bridge' centreline (9acda0c5-67fc-3956-afc8-9a8e333ae3db, endpoints 37.8081298,-122.4764734 to 37.8323305,-122.4807209), with the south tower placed 335 m offshore of the DEM's south shoreline crossing and the north tower one published 1280.2 m main span beyond it. Corroboration: that lands the north tower 5 m from the DEM's north shoreline crossing, which is where it is known to stand. Dimensions are the published figures: 227.4 m tower height, 67.1 m deck clearance, 27.4 m deck width.
